player_prompt.intro:
A yiɗa {color} caggal Breakthrough. A yiɗa {direction} dow mbalɗa {board_size}x{board_size}.
Caggal ma a yiɗa, a waraɓɗa ngo tataɓo oɗaɗo moɗo moɗo.
Ngo tataɓo oɗaɗo yiɗa dow koreeji moɗo, so oɗaɗo moɗo yiɗa dow moɗo moɗo, a waraɓɗa moɗo moɗo.
So a yiɗa dow moɗo moɗo oɗaɗo moɗo, a hawta moɗo moɗo, oɗaɗo moɗo aɓɓaɗa moɗo.
A yiɗa dow notation UCI dow koreeji, e.g. [a2a3] a yiɗa dow a2 a3.
* 'a' yiɗa dow column koreeji, '1' yiɗa dow row koreeji (dow White's perspective).
* Blacks's home row yiɗa dow row ɓurɗo (row 8 dow 8x8). White's home row yiɗa dow row koreeji (row 1 dow 8x8).
A yiɗa dow player oɗaɗo moɗo yiɗa dow opponent's home row, oɗaɗo moɗo a yiɗa. So a yiɗa dow pieces moɗo a hawta, a yiɗa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E foondu naftora tinndol aljebira je ɗon nder ɓernde bana [a2a3].
invalid_move.illegal: Ɗa'an jahal ɗon tokka dookaaji Breakthrough ko boo ɗum wala kujeeji maaɗa.

outcome.white_reached: White yiɗa dow Black's home row.
outcome.black_reached: Black yiɗa dow White's home row.
